title: Self-Evolving Evaluation Environments for Computer-Use Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.30962v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Computer-use agents (CUAs) are rapidly improving, yet their evaluation remains largely static. Existing benchmarks provide a strong foundation, but fixed difficulty ceilings, limited feature coverage, and coarse aggregate scores progressively weaken their discriminative and diagnostic value. We introduce CUA-SEE, a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers from rollout evidence. It disentangles three objectives: benchmark evolution expands evaluation scope through cohort-calibrated difficulty and coverage growth; diagnostic evolution increases resolution through agent-conditional capability-boundary probes; and verifier evolution improves precision by translating changing requirements into state-grounded checkpoints with adversarial validation. Across multiple agents, applications, and rounds, CUA-SEE generates challenging, measurable tasks while preserving process-level evidence. Our results posit

translated_title: 面向计算机使用智能体的自进化评估环境
translated_abstract: 计算机使用智能体（CUAs）正在快速进步，但其评估方法在很大程度上仍然是静态的。现有基准测试提供了坚实的基础，但固定的难度上限、有限的功能覆盖范围以及粗粒度的聚合评分逐渐削弱了其区分能力和诊断价值。我们提出了CUA-SEE，这是一个闭环评估环境，能够根据执行轨迹证据共同进化任务和可执行验证器。它将三个目标解耦：基准进化通过群体校准的难度和覆盖范围增长来扩展评估范围；诊断进化通过面向智能体的能力边界探测来提高分辨率；验证器进化通过将不断变化的需求转化为基于状态的检查点并进行对抗验证来提高精度。在跨多个智能体、应用程序和轮次的测试中，CUA-SEE生成了具有挑战性且可度量的任务，同时保留了过程级证据。
tldr: 本文提出CUA-SEE，一个基于执行轨迹证据共同进化任务与可执行验证器的闭环评估环境，通过基准进化、诊断进化和验证器进化三个解耦目标，为计算机使用智能体提供动态、精细化且精确的评估能力。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces CUA-SEE, a closed-loop evaluation environment that co-evolves tasks and executable verifiers from rollout evidence, offering dynamic, fine-grained, and precise evaluation of computer-use agents through three disentangled objectives: benchmark evolution, diagnostic evolution, and verifier evolution.
